scenario.name: r-cw-3-reason-telemetry
scenario.description: continue_work reason telemetry/redaction partial candidate. k6 proves schedule+wake and keeps the raw reason out of public artifacts; Tempo JSON review must verify safe reason attrs present and raw reason absent before a PASS fold.

invocation.reason: k6-proof-R-CW-3-redaction RAW-RCW3-{{nonce}}; on continuation wake reply exactly CW3-WOKE {{nonce}}

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the sessions.send turn that asks the agent to call continue_work with a nonce-bearing reason.

expectedReceipts.name: continue-work-tool-result-scheduled
expectedReceipts.description: Agent emitted CW3-SCHEDULED only after the continue_work tool result reported scheduled.

expectedReceipts.name: work-woke-event
expectedReceipts.description: Continuation wake turn emitted CW3-WOKE nonce sentinel.

expectedReceipts.name: public-artifact-raw-reason-absent
expectedReceipts.description: Scenario public evidence redacts the raw reason sentinel rather than committing it.

expectedReceipts.name: tempo-trace-json
expectedReceipts.description: Fetched Tempo trace JSON for reviewer validation of reason telemetry/redaction.

expectedReceipts.name: reason-telemetry-redaction-review
expectedReceipts.description: Reviewer confirms safe reason attrs are present and the raw reason sentinel is absent from Tempo JSON before folding PASS.

review.notes: This row remains PARTIAL-candidate until Tempo trace JSON is fetched and reviewed for safe reason attrs present / raw reason absent.

census.limits: This row is the closest to satisfied: reason.hash and reason.length are genuinely exported, so the redaction half of its claim is telemetry-backed. The provenance half is not — the census established that the accepted entry span carrying those reason attributes has no origin, session, or turn identity, so a reviewer can prove the reason was redacted and still cannot prove whose turn produced it.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and already asserted by the row’s trace-correlation resolver. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
The safe reason attribute this row exists to verify.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: The raw reason sentinel must be absent from every public artifact and from every exported span attribute; only the digest and the length may appear. This is the row’s subject matter, not an incidental precaution.

controls.positive: Safe reason attributes are present in the fetched Tempo JSON and the scheduled/wake sentinels are observed.
controls.negative: The raw reason sentinel is absent from the Tempo JSON and from the committed artifacts. A run that cannot fetch the Tempo JSON cannot assert either side.
controls.notes: The negative control is a redaction proof and requires a real trace fetch; it is the reason this row is capped at PARTIAL-candidate until a reviewer reads the JSON.

backendUnavailable.notes: A degraded backend removes the trace JSON and therefore both halves of the redaction claim. The row stays PARTIAL-candidate, which is already its declared expected artifact class.

verdictAuthority.pass: Reserved for a reviewed fold: safe reason attributes present and raw reason absent in the fetched Tempo JSON, on top of the schedule and wake receipts.
verdictAuthority.partial: The row’s unattended class. Trace fetch or reviewer confirmation outstanding, or the backend is degraded or partial.
verdictAuthority.fail: The raw reason sentinel appears in an exported span attribute or in a committed artifact.

execution.deterministicK6: r-cw-3-reason-telemetry.js fires the row and keeps the raw reason out of public artifacts.
execution.manual: A reviewer must read the fetched Tempo JSON and confirm safe attributes present and raw reason absent before any PASS fold.
execution.relationship: This row is explicitly manual-gated: the deterministic run can reach PARTIAL-candidate unattended and only the reviewer step can lift it.

liveRunSafety.notes: Safe unattended live fire, but not an unattended PASS proof: trace fetch/review decides whether the reason telemetry claim can be folded. Disposable-session smoke may honestly stop at scheduled-only on runtimes where disposable sessions do not service self-elected continuation wakes; canonical fold also requires a CW3-WOKE receipt.
